apps.name: Fluxa
apps.subtitle: Your media, in one place.
apps.versionDescription:
## What's Changed

- fix(host): keep addon line breaks in stream names (`221f45b6`)
- fix(plugins): fall back to the imdb id when tmdb cannot be resolved (`495b4dd8`)
- fix(player): rebuild the episode id when a resumed video id mismatches (`c204c8b1`)
- fix(player): show viewing presence while picking a source (`02735274`)
- fix(ui): loosen detail line spacing in stream cards (`1ee1094f`)
- fix(desktop): back the stream list column with the theme background (`2ca6047b`)
- fix(ui): give emojis real width in stream text (`7195c19c`)
- fix(ci): keep android rust libraries out of release assets (`0afc2bbb`)
- fix(host): export challenge solver functions only on non-wasm targets (`96a37cac`)
- feat(detail): mark episodes and seasons watched from a long-press menu (`6d3fe6b2`)
- fix(desktop): stop update banner flicker and keep it clear of the fullscreen button (`14473ed3`)
- Apply the frame interpolation setting through the mpv fork's motion profiles (`bfc05e4f`)
- Select Anime4K via the mpv fork's enhance-anime profiles instead of bundling shader chains (`b39687e9`)
- Load desktop Anime4K shaders from the mpv fork's builtin:// store (`58138e70`)
- Load Anime4K shaders from the mpv fork's builtin:// store on Android and Apple (`64c4d9de`)
